agent-system.description: Global agent-system root (this repo, installed at ~/.config/opencode). Its assets (e.g. protocols/, workflows/, agents/, scripts/, tests/, templates/) are NOT resolvable by relative or alias paths — join THIS reference's absolute root with the relative path to read an asset (e.g. ROOT/protocols/prompt-pipeline.md). Never commit machine-specific absolute paths; resolve the root at runtime from this reference.
